title: Body buzzing for no clear reason?
caption: Body buzzing for no clear reason? The sky is quiet and steady today, so there’s more room to recoup, even if you’re not feeling better yet—do one focused block, then pause, and get some daylight with a short, easy walk.
snapshot: Geomagnetic activity sits in a quiet range. Solar wind looks ordinary for this time, without sharp jumps. The field leans a bit south at times, not in a forceful way. No flares were logged in the past day. A few solar bursts were observed, with no signs of arrival.
affects: Steadier space helps some people find longer, cleaner focus blocks and a calmer baseline. If your body’s still carrying a slight buzz from earlier in the week, it can take a day or two to downshift. Local weather can still add load—check pressure changes, storms, smoke, or allergens where you live. Evening routines may feel a touch easier to settle into tonight.
playbook:
- Do one focused block, then pause
- Get daylight and a short, easy walk
- Keep caffeine earlier to protect wind‑down
- Try slow breathing for 5–10 min if jittery
- Peek at local weather, air, and allergens
